question.prompt: A product costs 30 yuan per unit and sells for $x$ yuan ($30\le x\le 50$). Daily sales are $160-2x$ units. Find the maximum daily profit. (Unit: yuan.)

solutions.explanation: $w=(x-30)(160-2x)=-2(x-55)^2+1250$. The vertex at $x=55$ is outside $30\le x\le 50$. Within the interval, $w$ increases as $x$ increases, so it is maximized at $x=50$, where $w=20\times 60=1200$.
solutions.title: Use the vertex and allowed price interval
Minimize the squared distance to the vertex
